title: Bounded Plan, Execute, Verify, Critique, Repair loop
statement: Bounded Plan, Execute, Verify, Critique, Repair loop
body: Proposed. Adopt, if the owner accepts: - [loop.cjs](../../harness/loop/loop.cjs) with [loop-policy.json](../../harness/policy/loop-policy.json), the CLI [loop.mjs](../../harness/scripts/loop.mjs), and `validate-loop` in `npm run validate` and CI, as described in [LOOP](../loop/LOOP.md). - PASSED reachable only from a verification the loop ran on the final files, plus an independent approval where the task requires one. - Failure classes that stop at once (hard constraint, permission, isolation, sensitive data, missing context, unsafe action, tampering, untracked change), that escalate (repeated failure, budget, non-idempotent failure, blocked review, a policy failure with no declared constraint) or that are repairable within 3 repair attempts and 2 identical failures; a diagnosis with a different approach before any repair that follows a failed repair. - `docs/state/loops/` as a control-plane path and the loop CLI on no agent's command list: only a person drives a loop in this stage. - A pinned TypeScript toolchain outside the manifest, verified before use. - No sandbox and no agent-run loop yet; both are recorded as open items (R15, T24).
subject: adr.0011
